Introduction
This document lists the equipment Inspection checklist I2, which must be performed on a weekly bases as 
 indicated by M6 in the above title block.
The first draft initiated by: eng. Abdel Aziz El Bagoury, tested by eng. 
 Doaa Anis, revised by quality control eng. Adel Abdel Qader El Nagar at EDEPCo., 
 accepted by general director eng. Mahmoud Saker and approved by eng. Mostafa 
 Alam Head Sector of Talkha PS
Safety 
Precaution
A work 
 order must be issued and the qualified maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety 
 category,
Transformer isolation and proper grounding on 
 all its sides is required.
Safety fence (rope) with caution marks

Before

 breathing mask to protect lung tissues from the dust particulate.
Don't burn the cloth used in cleaning, collect it and send to the dump.
